measuredBaseline.note: Measured against the P6-05..P6-09 build (vite-project/dist) served via `vite preview` on this dev machine, headless Chrome, single run, no network throttling emulation beyond Lighthouse's default. Performance is scored low mainly by bundle size (see check-bundle-size.cjs budgets — the 532KB vendor + 276KB ethers chunks dominate). Budgets below are set at/near this measured baseline, not an aspirational target, so CI fails only on a real regression from where the app already is.
